mapper.sql: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_USER actor JOIN DOCS_USER_SECURITY_CLEARANCE clearance ON clearance.USER_CD = actor.USER_CD AND clearance.VALID_FROM <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (clearance.VALID_TO IS NULL OR clearance.VALID_TO > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) JOIN DOCS_SECURITY_GRADE userGrade ON userGrade.GRADE_CD = clearance.GRADE_CD AND userGrade.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE actor.USER_CD = #{aclUserCd} AND actor.USE_YN = 'Y' AND actor.DEL_YN = 'N' AND COALESCE(actor.LOCK_YN, 'N') != 'Y' AND userGrade.GRADE_LEVEL >= ( SELECT fileGrade.GRADE_LEVEL FROM DOCS_FILE_SECURITY_LABEL documentLabel JOIN DOCS_SECURITY_GRADE fileGrade ON fileGrade.GRADE_CD = documentLabel.GRADE_CD AND fileGrade.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE documentLabel.OBJECT_TYPE = 'SW' AND documentLabel.OBJECT_ID = info.OBJECT_ID AND documentLabel.FILE_NO = '*' ORDER BY fileGrade.GRADE_LEVEL DESC NULLS LAST, documentLabel.LABEL_ID DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_USER_ACTION_PERMISSION actionPermission WHERE actionPermission.USER_CD = actor.USER_CD AND actionPermission.ACTION_CD = 'LIST' AND actionPermission.ALLOW_YN = 'Y' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_OBJECT_USER_PERMISSION objectPermission WHERE objectPermission.OBJECT_TYPE = 'SW' AND objectPermission.OBJECT_ID = info.OBJECT_ID AND objectPermission.USER_CD = actor.USER_CD AND objectPermission.ACTION_CD = 'LIST' AND objectPermission.ALLOW_YN = 'Y' ) )
mapper.select: SELECT tree.TREE_CD AS comboVal , tree.TREE_NM AS comboLabel , tree.TREE_NM AS comboTooltip FROM DOCS_SW_TREE tree WHERE COALESCE(tree.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(tree.UPPER_TREE_CD, '') = 'ROOT' ORDER BY tree.TREE_CD

SELECT tree.TREE_CD AS comboVal , tree.TREE_NM AS comboLabel , tree.UPPER_TREE_CD AS comboTooltip FROM DOCS_SW_TREE tree WHERE COALESCE(tree.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(tree.UPPER_TREE_CD, '') != 'ROOT' ORDER BY tree.TREE_CD

SELECT COALESCE( MAX( CASE WHEN split_part(SW_NO, '-', 4) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(split_part(SW_NO, '-', 4) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END ), 0 ) + 1 FROM DOCS_SW WHERE SW_NO LIKE 'K8-CCB-L%-%' AND COALESCE(DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND split_part(SW_NO, '-', 3) ~ '^L[0-9]+$' AND CAST(SUBSTRING(split_part(SW_NO, '-', 3) FROM 2) AS INTEGER) = CAST(#{levelNo} AS INTEGER)

WITH RECURSIVE active_tree AS ( SELECT tree.TREE_CD, tree.UPPER_TREE_CD, tree.TREE_NM, tree.TREE_DEPTH, tree.SORT_ORDER, tree.USE_YN, tree.TREE_PATH FROM DOCS_SW_TREE tree WHERE COALESCE(tree.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ), tree_descendants (ancestor_cd, descendant_cd) AS ( SELECT tree.TREE_CD, tree.TREE_CD FROM active_tree tree UNION SELECT relation.ancestor_cd, child.TREE_CD FROM tree_descendants relation JOIN active_tree child ON child.UPPER_TREE_CD = relation.descendant_cd ), accessible_documents AS ( SELECT DISTINCT info.OBJECT_ID, COALESCE(NULLIF(info.TREE_CD, ''), NULLIF(info.BUSINESS_TYPE_CD, '')) AS TREE_CD FROM DOCS_SW info WHERE COALESCE(info.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_SW_FILE mainFile WHERE mainFile.OBJECT_ID = info.OBJECT_ID )
), tree_document_counts AS ( SELECT relation.ancestor_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT documentInfo.OBJECT_ID)::integer AS document_count FROM tree_descendants relation JOIN accessible_documents documentInfo ON documentInfo.TREE_CD = relation.descendant_cd GROUP BY relation.ancestor_cd ) SELECT tree.TREE_CD AS id , COALESCE(tree.UPPER_TREE_CD, '#') AS parent , tree.TREE_NM AS text , CAST(tree.TREE_DEPTH AS VARCHAR) AS "level" , CASE WHEN tree.UPPER_TREE_CD IS NULL THEN 'root' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_SW_TREE child WHERE child.UPPER_TREE_CD = tree.TREE_CD AND COALESCE(child.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y') THEN 'group' ELSE 'item' END AS "type" , tree.SORT_ORDER AS sort , COALESCE(tree.USE_YN, 'Y') AS useYn , CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_SW_TREE child WHERE child.UPPER_TREE_CD = tree.TREE_CD AND COALESCE(child.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y') THEN '' ELSE 'swTreeCd' END AS filterType , tree.TREE_NM AS filterValue , tree.TREE_CD AS swTreeCd , '' AS distributeTypeCd , COALESCE(documentCount.document_count, 0) AS "documentCount" FROM active_tree tree LEFT JOIN tree_document_counts documentCount ON documentCount.ancestor_cd = tree.TREE_CD ORDER BY tree.TREE_PATH, tree.SORT_ORDER, tree.TREE_NM

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM ( SELECT A1.* FROM ( SELECT info.* , insertuser.USER_NM AS insertUserNm , updateUser.USER_NM AS updateUserNm
FROM ( SELECT info.BUSINESS_TYPE_CD AS businessTypeCd, FN_GET_CD_NM('businessTypeCd', info.BUSINESS_TYPE_CD, 'ko') AS businessTypeNm, info.SW_TYPE_CD AS swTypeCd, FN_GET_CD_NM('swTypeCd', info.SW_TYPE_CD, 'ko') AS swTypeNm, info.DISTRIBUTE_TYPE_CD AS distributeTypeCd, -- FN_GET_CD_NM('distributeTypeCd', info.DISTRIBUTE_TYPE_CD, 'ko') AS distributeTypeNm, info.DISTRIBUTE_TYPE_NAME AS distributeTypeNm, info.SW_NO AS swNo, info.SW_NM AS swNm, info.SW_VERSION_No AS swVersionNo, info.OBJECT_ID AS objectId, info.REV_NO AS revNo, info.INSERT_UID AS insertUid, info.UPDATE_UID AS updateUid, info.ecn_insert_uid AS ecn_insert_uid, info.REGISTER_USER AS registerUser, info.INSERT_DEPT_NM AS insertDeptNm, info.STD_GAPP_DT AS stdGappDt, info.CHANGE_GAPP_DT AS changeGappDt, info.ECN_NO AS ecnNo, info.BUSINESS_AREA_CD AS businessAreaCd, FN_GET_CD_NM('businessAreaCdAll', info.BUSINESS_AREA_CD, 'ko') AS businessAreaNm, info.PROTECT_YN AS protectYn, info.PROTECT_YN AS protectYnView, info.UPDATE_DT AS updateDt, info.INSERT_DT AS insertDt, info.CREATE_DT AS createDt, info.INTERFACE_DT AS interfaceDt, info.PRODUCT_CD AS productCd, COALESCE(info.PRODUCT_CD, '') AS productNm, ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DOCS_SW_FILE swFile WHERE swFile.OBJECT_ID = info.OBJECT_ID) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DOCS_SW_SUB_FILE subFile WHERE subFile.PARENT_OBJECT_ID = info.OBJECT_ID AND COALESCE(subFile.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y') ) AS fileCount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SW_NO ORDER BY REV_NO DESC) AS rnk, fileInfo.FILE_NO AS fileNo, fileInfo.ORG_FILE_NM AS fileViewNm, fileInfo.FILE_NM AS fileNm, fileInfo.FILE_SIZE AS fileSize, fileInfo.ORG_FILE_NM AS orgFileNm, fileInfo.FILE_PATH_NM AS filePath, info.VALID_TYPE AS validType FROM DOCS_SW_FILE fileInfo JOIN DOCS_SW info ON fileInfo.OBJECT_ID = info.OBJECT_ID
FROM ( SELECT info.BUSINESS_TYPE_CD AS businessTypeCd, FN_GET_CD_NM('businessTypeCd', info.BUSINESS_TYPE_CD, 'ko') AS businessTypeNm, info.SW_TYPE_CD AS swTypeCd, FN_GET_CD_NM('swTypeCd', info.SW_TYPE_CD, 'ko') AS swTypeNm, info.DISTRIBUTE_TYPE_CD AS distributeTypeCd, -- FN_GET_CD_NM('distributeTypeCd', info.DISTRIBUTE_TYPE_CD, 'ko') AS distributeTypeNm, info.DISTRIBUTE_TYPE_NAME AS distributeTypeNm, info.SW_NO AS swNo, info.SW_NM AS swNm, info.SW_VERSION_No AS swVersionNo, info.OBJECT_ID AS objectId, info.REV_NO AS revNo, info.INSERT_UID AS insertUid, info.UPDATE_UID AS updateUid, info.ecn_insert_uid AS ecn_insert_uid, info.REGISTER_USER AS registerUser, info.INSERT_DEPT_NM AS insertDeptNm, info.STD_GAPP_DT AS stdGappDt, info.CHANGE_GAPP_DT AS changeGappDt, info.ECN_NO AS ecnNo, info.BUSINESS_AREA_CD AS businessAreaCd, FN_GET_CD_NM('businessAreaCdAll', info.BUSINESS_AREA_CD, 'ko') AS businessAreaNm, info.PROTECT_YN AS protectYn, info.PROTECT_YN AS protectYnView, info.UPDATE_DT AS updateDt, info.INSERT_DT AS insertDt, info.CREATE_DT AS createDt, info.INTERFACE_DT AS interfaceDt, info.PRODUCT_CD AS productCd, COALESCE(info.PRODUCT_CD, '') AS productNm, ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DOCS_SW_FILE swFile WHERE swFile.OBJECT_ID = info.OBJECT_ID) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DOCS_SW_SUB_FILE subFile WHERE subFile.PARENT_OBJECT_ID = info.OBJECT_ID AND COALESCE(subFile.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y') ) AS fileCount, fileInfo.FILE_NO AS fileNo, fileInfo.ORG_FILE_NM AS fileViewNm, fileInfo.FILE_NM AS fileNm, fileInfo.FILE_SIZE AS fileSize, fileInfo.ORG_FILE_NM AS orgFileNm, fileInfo.FILE_PATH_NM AS filePath, info.VALID_TYPE AS validType FROM DOCS_SW_FILE fileInfo JOIN DOCS_SW info ON fileInfo.OBJECT_ID = info.OBJECT_ID
WHERE 1=1 AND info.DELETED_YN = 'N'
AND BUSINESS_TYPE_CD = #{businessTypeCd}
AND BUSINESS_AREA_CD LIKE '%' || #{businessAreaCd} || '%'
AND SW_NO = UPPER(TRIM(#{swNo}))
AND SW_NO LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(#{swNo})) || '%'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_SW_TREE node JOIN DOCS_SW_TREE selectedNode ON selectedNode.TREE_CD IN
#{treeCd}
WHERE node.TREE_CD = info.TREE_CD AND node.TREE_PATH LIKE selectedNode.TREE_PATH || '%' )
AND info.SW_NM LIKE '%' || #{swNm} || '%'
AND ( fileInfo.ORG_FILE_NM LIKE '%' || #{fileViewNm} || '%' OR fileInfo.FILE_NM LIKE '%' || #{fileViewNm} || '%' )
AND fileInfo.FILE_NM LIKE '%' || #{fileNm} || '%'
AND SW_TYPE_CD LIKE '%' || #{swTypeCd} || '%'
AND info.DISTRIBUTE_TYPE_CD = #{distributeTypeCd}
AND ECN_NO LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(#{ecnNo})) || '%'
AND PRODUCT_CD = #{productCd}
AND INSERT_UID = #{insertUid}
AND VALID_TYPE IS NULL
AND VALID_TYPE = 'N'
AND info.INTERFACE_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{interfaceStartDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{interfaceEndDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
AND(
(SW_NO LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(#{swInfo.swNo})) || '%')
)
AND(
(SW_NO = UPPER(TRIM(#{swInfo.swNo})) )
)
) info LEFT JOIN DOCS_USER insertUser ON insertUser.USER_ID = info.insertUid LEFT JOIN DOCS_USER updateUser ON updateUser.USER_ID = info.updateUid
WHERE rnk = 1
) A1 WHERE 1=1 ) B1
mapper.insert:
/* */ SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(CN_SERIAL AS INTEGER)), 0)+1 AS cnSerial FROM DOCS_SW
/* DOCS_SW 추가 */ INSERT INTO DOCS_SW ( OBJECT_ID, CN_SERIAL, INSERT_DT, CCBDATE, BUSINESS_AREA_CD, BUSINESS_TYPE_CD, TREE_CD, SW_NO, SW_NM, DISTRIBUTE_TYPE_CD, PROTECT_YN, INSERT_UID, REV_NO, SW_VERSION_NO, DOC_VERSION_NO, APPROVER, REVIEWERUSER, APPROVED_USERS, STATUS, INTERFACE_DT, REGISTER_USER, SW_TYPE_CD) VALUES ( #{objectId}, CAST(#{cnSerial} AS INTEGER), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CAST(NULLIF(#{ccbIssueDt}, '') AS DATE), #{sessionUser.businessAreaCd}, #{businessTypeCd}, #{treeCd}, #{swNo}, #{fileNm}, #{distributeTypeCd}, #{protectYn}, #{sessionUser.userId}, #{revNo}, #{swVersion}, #{docVersion}, #{approver}, #{reviewerUser}, '', #{statusCd}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sessionUser.userNm}, ''), #{sessionUser.username}), #{swType})

/* 조회 */ SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(CN_SERIAL AS INTEGER)), 0)+0 AS cnSerial FROM DOCS_SW
/* DOCS_SW_FILE 추가 */ INSERT INTO DOCS_SW_FILE ( OBJECT_ID, CN_SERIAL, INTERFACE_DT, FILE_SIZE, ORG_FILE_NM, FILE_NO, DISTRIBUTE_TYPE_CD, FILE_PATH_NM, REGISTER_USER, PROCESSING_STATUS, PROCESSING_ERROR, PROCESSED_AT) VALUES ( #{objectId}, CAST(#{cnSerial} AS INTEGER), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{fileSize}, #{orgFileNm}, #{fileNo}, #{distributeTypeCd}, #{filePath}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sessionUser.userNm}, ''), #{sessionUser.username}), 'DONE', NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(FILE_NO), 0) + 1 FROM DOCS_SW_SUB_FILE WHERE PARENT_OBJECT_ID = #{parentObjectId}
INSERT INTO DOCS_SW_SUB_FILE (OBJECT_ID, PARENT_OBJECT_ID, FILE_NO, ORG_FILE_NM, FILE_PATH_NM, FILE_SIZE, USE_YN, INSERT_UID, INSERT_DT, UPDATE_UID, UPDATE_DT) VALUES (#{objectId}, #{parentObjectId}, CAST(#{fileNo} AS INTEGER), #{orgFileNm}, #{filePath}, CAST(#{fileSize} AS BIGINT), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{useYn}, ''), 'Y'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sessionUser.userId}, ''), #{sessionUser.username}), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT info.OBJECT_ID AS objectId, COALESCE(info.INSERT_UID, '') AS insertUid, COALESCE(insertUser.USER_NM, COALESCE(info.REGISTER_USER, '')) AS insertUserNm, COALESCE(info.APPROVER, '') AS approver, COALESCE(info.REVIEWERUSER, '') AS reviewerUser, COALESCE(info.APPROVED_USERS, '') AS approvedUsers, COALESCE(info.STATUS, '') AS status, COALESCE(info.REV_NO, '') AS revNo, COALESCE(info.DELETED_YN, 'N') AS deletedYn FROM DOCS_SW info LEFT JOIN DOCS_USER insertUser ON insertUser.USER_ID = info.INSERT_UID WHERE info.OBJECT_ID = #{objectId}
mapper.update: UPDATE DOCS_SW SET APPROVED_USERS = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM regexp_split_to_table(COALESCE(APPROVED_USERS, ''), ',') AS au(token) WHERE split_part(TRIM(au.token), '|', 1) = split_part(#{approvedUser}, '|', 1) ) THEN COALESCE(APPROVED_USERS, '') WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(APPROVED_USERS), ''), '') = '' THEN #{approvedUser} ELSE COALESCE(APPROVED_USERS, '') || ',' || #{approvedUser} END, STATUS = CASE WHEN #{isFinal} = 'Y' THEN '승인완료' ELSE '승인진행중' END WHERE OBJECT_ID = #{objectId} AND COALESCE(DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N'

UPDATE DOCS_SW_FILE SET FILE_PATH_NM = #{filePath}, FILE_SIZE = #{fileSize}, PROCESSING_STATUS = 'DONE', PROCESSING_ERROR = NULL, PROCESSED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE OBJECT_ID = #{objectId} AND CAST(FILE_NO AS INTEGER) = 1
UPDATE DOCS_SW_FILE SET PROCESSING_STATUS = 'FAIL', PROCESSING_ERROR = #{errorMessage}, PROCESSED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE OBJECT_ID = #{objectId} AND CAST(FILE_NO AS INTEGER) = 1
mapper.select: SELECT sw.OBJECT_ID AS "objectId", sw.SW_NO AS "swNo", fileInfo.FILE_NO AS "fileNo", fileInfo.ORG_FILE_NM AS "orgFileNm", fileInfo.FILE_SIZE AS "fileSize", securityGrade.grade_cd AS "gradeCd", securityGrade.grade_nm AS "gradeNm", securityGrade.grade_level AS "gradeLevel", COALESCE(fileInfo.PROCESSING_STATUS, '') AS "processingStatus", fileInfo.FILE_PATH_NM AS "filePath" FROM DOCS_SW sw JOIN DOCS_SW_FILE fileInfo ON fileInfo.OBJECT_ID = sw.OBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT label.grade_cd, grade.grade_nm, grade.grade_level FROM docs_file_security_label label LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade grade ON grade.grade_cd = label.grade_cd WHERE label.object_type = 'SW' AND label.object_id = sw.OBJECT_ID AND label.file_no IN (CAST(fileInfo.FILE_NO AS TEXT), '*') ORDER BY grade.grade_level DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN label.file_no = CAST(fileInfo.FILE_NO AS TEXT) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1 ) securityGrade ON TRUE WHERE sw.OBJECT_ID = #{objectId} AND COALESCE(sw.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND CAST(fileInfo.FILE_NO AS INTEGER) = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT sw.SW_NO AS "swNo", sw.SW_NM AS "swNm", COALESCE( NULLIF(REPLACE(TRIM(BOTH '/' FROM swTree.TREE_PATH), '/', ' > '), ''), NULLIF(swTree.TREE_NM, ''), '' ) AS "classificationPath", COALESCE(NULLIF(sw.PRODUCT_CD, ''), NULLIF(sw.MODEL_CODE, ''), '') AS "productNm", COALESCE(NULLIF(sw.REGISTER_USER, ''), NULLIF(insertUser.USER_NM, ''), NULLIF(sw.INSERT_UID, ''), '') AS "registerUser", COALESCE(NULLIF(insertUser.USER_NM, ''), NULLIF(sw.REGISTER_USER, ''), NULLIF(sw.INSERT_UID, ''), '') AS "insertUserNm", COALESCE(sw.INSERT_DEPT_NM, '') AS "insertDeptNm", COALESCE(TO_CHAR(sw.INSERT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), '') AS "insertDt", ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DOCS_SW_FILE countedMain WHERE countedMain.OBJECT_ID = sw.OBJECT_ID) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DOCS_SW_SUB_FILE countedSub WHERE countedSub.PARENT_OBJECT_ID = sw.OBJECT_ID AND COALESCE(countedSub.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y') ) AS "fileCount" FROM DOCS_SW sw LEFT JOIN DOCS_USER insertUser ON insertUser.USER_ID = sw.INSERT_UID LEFT JOIN DOCS_SW_TREE swTree ON swTree.TREE_CD = COALESCE(NULLIF(sw.TREE_CD, ''), sw.BUSINESS_TYPE_CD) WHERE sw.OBJECT_ID = #{objectId} AND COALESCE(sw.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' LIMIT 1

SELECT fileInfo.OBJECT_ID AS "objectId", fileInfo.PARENT_OBJECT_ID AS "parentObjectId", fileInfo.FILE_NO AS "fileNo", fileInfo.ORG_FILE_NM AS "orgFileNm", fileInfo.FILE_SIZE AS "fileSize", securityGrade.grade_cd AS "gradeCd", securityGrade.grade_nm AS "gradeNm", securityGrade.grade_level AS "gradeLevel", fileInfo.FILE_PATH_NM AS "filePath" FROM DOCS_SW_SUB_FILE fileInfo LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT label.grade_cd, grade.grade_nm, grade.grade_level FROM docs_file_security_label label LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade grade ON grade.grade_cd = label.grade_cd WHERE label.object_id = fileInfo.PARENT_OBJECT_ID AND ( (label.object_type = 'SW_SUB' AND label.file_no IN (CAST(fileInfo.FILE_NO AS TEXT), '*')) OR (label.object_type = 'SW' AND label.file_no = '*') ) ORDER BY grade.grade_level DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN label.object_type = 'SW_SUB' AND label.file_no = CAST(fileInfo.FILE_NO AS TEXT) THEN 0 WHEN label.object_type = 'SW_SUB' AND label.file_no = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1 ) securityGrade ON TRUE WHERE fileInfo.PARENT_OBJECT_ID = #{objectId} AND COALESCE(fileInfo.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY CAST(fileInfo.FILE_NO AS INTEGER)
SELECT OBJECT_ID AS "objectId", APPROVER_ID AS "approverId", COALESCE(COMMENT_TXT, '') AS "comment" FROM DOCS_SW_APPROVAL_COMMENT WHERE OBJECT_ID = #{objectId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO DOCS_SW_APPROVAL_COMMENT ( OBJECT_ID, APPROVER_ID, COMMENT_TXT, UPDATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{objectId}, #{approverId}, #{comment}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (OBJECT_ID, APPROVER_ID) DO UPDATE SET COMMENT_TXT = EXCLUDED.COMMENT_TXT, UPDATE_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

#{name}

mapper.sql: actor_context AS ( SELECT userInfo.USER_CD AS user_cd, userInfo.USER_ID AS user_id, currentClearance.GRADE_CD AS user_grade_cd, currentClearance.GRADE_NM AS user_grade_nm, COALESCE(currentClearance.GRADE_LEVEL, -1) AS user_grade_level, currentClearance.VALID_FROM AS user_grade_valid_from, currentClearance.VALID_TO AS user_grade_valid_to, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_USER_ACTION_PERMISSION listPermission WHERE listPermission.USER_CD = userInfo.USER_CD AND listPermission.ACTION_CD = 'LIST' AND listPermission.ALLOW_YN = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS list_yn, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_USER_ACTION_PERMISSION viewPermission WHERE viewPermission.USER_CD = userInfo.USER_CD AND viewPermission.ACTION_CD = 'VIEW' AND viewPermission.ALLOW_YN = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS view_yn, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_USER_ACTION_PERMISSION downloadPermission WHERE downloadPermission.USER_CD = userInfo.USER_CD AND downloadPermission.ACTION_CD = 'DOWNLOAD_ORIGINAL' AND downloadPermission.ALLOW_YN = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS download_original_yn, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_USER_ACTION_PERMISSION printPermission WHERE printPermission.USER_CD = userInfo.USER_CD AND printPermission.ACTION_CD = 'PRINT' AND printPermission.ALLOW_YN = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS print_yn FROM DOCS_USER userInfo LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT userGrade.GRADE_CD, userGrade.GRADE_NM, userGrade.GRADE_LEVEL, clearance.VALID_FROM, clearance.VALID_TO FROM DOCS_USER_SECURITY_CLEARANCE clearance JOIN DOCS_SECURITY_GRADE userGrade ON userGrade.GRADE_CD = clearance.GRADE_CD AND userGrade.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE clearance.USER_CD = userInfo.USER_CD AND clearance.VALID_FROM <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (clearance.VALID_TO IS NULL OR clearance.VALID_TO > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY userGrade.GRADE_LEVEL DESC, clearance.VALID_TO DESC NULLS FIRST, clearance.VALID_FROM DESC LIMIT 1 ) currentClearance ON TRUE WHERE userInfo.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND userInfo.USE_YN = 'Y' AND userInfo.DEL_YN = 'N' AND COALESCE(userInfo.LOCK_YN, 'N') != 'Y' ), latest_sw AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (sw.OBJECT_ID) sw.* FROM DOCS_SW sw WHERE COALESCE(sw.DELETED_YN, 'N') != 'Y' AND sw.OBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sw.OBJECT_ID, COALESCE(sw.INTERFACE_DT, sw.UPDATE_DT, sw.INSERT_DT, sw.CREATE_DT) DESC NULLS LAST, sw.CN_SERIAL DESC NULLS LAST ), document_scope AS ( SELECT sw.*, fileGrade.GRADE_CD AS dashboard_grade_cd, fileGrade.GRADE_NM AS dashboard_grade_nm, fileGrade.GRADE_LEVEL AS dashboard_grade_level FROM latest_sw sw CROSS JOIN actor_context actor LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT securityLabel.GRADE_CD FROM DOCS_FILE_SECURITY_LABEL securityLabel LEFT JOIN DOCS_SECURITY_GRADE candidateGrade ON candidateGrade.GRADE_CD = securityLabel.GRADE_CD WHERE securityLabel.OBJECT_TYPE = 'SW' AND securityLabel.OBJECT_ID = sw.OBJECT_ID AND securityLabel.FILE_NO = '*' ORDER BY candidateGrade.GRADE_LEVEL DESC NULLS LAST, securityLabel.LABEL_ID DESC LIMIT 1 ) effectiveLabel ON TRUE LEFT JOIN DOCS_SECURITY_GRADE fileGrade ON fileGrade.GRADE_CD = effectiveLabel.GRADE_CD AND fileGrade.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE fileGrade.GRADE_CD IS NOT NULL AND actor.user_grade_level >= fileGrade.GRADE_LEVEL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_USER_ACTION_PERMISSION actionPermission WHERE actionPermission.USER_CD = actor.user_cd AND actionPermission.ACTION_CD = 'LIST' AND actionPermission.ALLOW_YN = 'Y' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_OBJECT_USER_PERMISSION objectPermission WHERE objectPermission.OBJECT_TYPE = 'SW' AND objectPermission.OBJECT_ID = sw.OBJECT_ID AND objectPermission.USER_CD = actor.user_cd AND objectPermission.ACTION_CD = 'LIST' AND objectPermission.ALLOW_YN = 'Y' ) )
mapper.select:
WITH
SELECT scopeCount.total_document_count AS "totalDocumentCount", scopeCount.total_document_count AS "accessibleDocumentCount", scopeCount.approved_document_count AS "approvedDocumentCount", scopeCount.approval_pending_count AS "approvalPendingCount", scopeCount.recent_document_count AS "recentDocumentCount", COALESCE(actor.user_grade_cd, 'UNASSIGNED') AS "userGradeCd", COALESCE(actor.user_grade_nm, '미인가') AS "userGradeNm", actor.user_grade_level::integer AS "userGradeLevel", TO_CHAR( actor.user_grade_valid_from AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS "clearanceValidFrom", TO_CHAR( actor.user_grade_valid_to AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS "clearanceValidTo", actor.list_yn AS "listAllowedYn", actor.view_yn AS "viewAllowedYn", actor.download_original_yn AS "downloadAllowedYn", actor.print_yn AS "printAllowedYn", ( SELECT COUNT(*)::integer FROM DOCS_ACCESS_AUDIT_LOG auditLog WHERE auditLog.OCCURRED_AT >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 days' AND auditLog.RESULT_CD = 'DENY' AND auditLog.OBJECT_TYPE IN ('SW', 'SW_SUB') AND auditLog.ACTOR_USER_CD = actor.user_cd ) AS "recentDeniedCount", ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT failedFile.OBJECT_ID)::integer FROM ( SELECT mainFile.OBJECT_ID FROM DOCS_SW_FILE mainFile WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(mainFile.PROCESSING_STATUS, '')) = 'FAIL' UNION ALL SELECT subFile.PARENT_OBJECT_ID AS OBJECT_ID FROM DOCS_SW_SUB_FILE subFile WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(subFile.PROCESSING_STATUS, '')) = 'FAIL' ) failedFile JOIN document_scope scopedDocument ON scopedDocument.OBJECT_ID = failedFile.OBJECT_ID ) AS "processingFailureCount", ( SELECT COUNT(*)::integer FROM DOCS_HISTORY viewHistory WHERE viewHistory.INSERT_DATE >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30 days' AND viewHistory.DISTRIBUTION_TYPE = 'CCB' AND viewHistory.LOG_TYPE = 'VIEWING' AND viewHistory.USER_ID = actor.user_id ) AS "viewCount30Days", ( SELECT COUNT(*)::integer FROM DOCS_ACCESS_AUDIT_LOG auditLog WHERE auditLog.OCCURRED_AT >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30 days' AND auditLog.EVENT_TYPE = 'DOWNLOAD_RESULT' AND auditLog.ACTION_TYPE = 'DOWNLOAD_ORIGINAL' AND auditLog.RESULT_CD = 'SUCCESS' AND auditLog.OBJECT_TYPE IN ('SW', 'SW_SUB') AND auditLog.ACTOR_USER_CD = actor.user_cd ) AS "downloadCount30Days", ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT printJob.PRINT_JOB_ID)::integer FROM DOCS_PRINT_JOB printJob JOIN DOCS_PRINT_JOB_ITEM printItem ON printItem.PRINT_JOB_ID = printJob.PRINT_JOB_ID WHERE printJob.COMPLETED_AT >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30 days' AND printJob.STATUS_CD = 'SUCCESS' AND printItem.OBJECT_TYPE IN ('SW', 'SW_SUB') AND printJob.ACTOR_USER_CD = actor.user_cd ) AS "printCount30Days", TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "generatedAt" FROM actor_context actor CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS total_document_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE documentInfo.STATUS = '승인완료' OR COALESCE(documentInfo.STATUS_CD, '') IN ('APPROVAL', 'ACCEPT', 'COMPLETE') )::integer AS approved_document_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE COALESCE(documentInfo.STATUS, '') != '승인완료' AND COALESCE(documentInfo.STATUS_CD, '') NOT IN ('APPROVAL', 'ACCEPT', 'COMPLETE') )::integer AS approval_pending_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE COALESCE(documentInfo.CREATE_DT, documentInfo.INSERT_DT, documentInfo.INPUT_DATE) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' )::integer AS recent_document_count FROM document_scope documentInfo ) scopeCount

WITH , grade_catalog AS ( SELECT grade.GRADE_CD, grade.GRADE_NM, grade.GRADE_LEVEL, grade.GRADE_LEVEL AS sort_level FROM DOCS_SECURITY_GRADE grade WHERE grade.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT 'UNASSIGNED', '미지정', 0, 2147483647 ), grade_count AS ( SELECT COALESCE(documentInfo.dashboard_grade_cd, 'UNASSIGNED') AS grade_cd, COUNT(*)::integer AS document_count FROM document_scope documentInfo GROUP BY COALESCE(documentInfo.dashboard_grade_cd, 'UNASSIGNED') ), document_total AS ( SELECT COUNT(*)::numeric AS total_count FROM document_scope ) SELECT gradeCatalog.GRADE_CD AS "gradeCd", gradeCatalog.GRADE_NM AS "gradeNm", gradeCatalog.GRADE_LEVEL::integer AS "gradeLevel", COALESCE(gradeCount.document_count, 0)::integer AS "documentCount", CASE WHEN documentTotal.total_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( COALESCE(gradeCount.document_count, 0) * 100.0 / documentTotal.total_count )::integer END AS "percentage" FROM grade_catalog gradeCatalog CROSS JOIN document_total documentTotal LEFT JOIN grade_count gradeCount ON gradeCount.grade_cd = gradeCatalog.GRADE_CD ORDER BY gradeCatalog.sort_level, gradeCatalog.GRADE_CD

WITH , status_rows AS ( SELECT CASE UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(documentInfo.STATUS), ''), 'UNASSIGNED')) WHEN '승인완료' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN '승인진행중' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN 'APPROVAL_IN_PROGRESS' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN '상태 미지정' THEN 'UNASSIGNED' WHEN 'UNASSIGNED' THEN 'UNASSIGNED' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS status_cd FROM document_scope documentInfo ) SELECT statusRows.status_cd AS "statusCd", COUNT(*)::integer AS "documentCount", ROUND( COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0) )::integer AS "percentage" FROM status_rows statusRows GROUP BY statusRows.status_cd ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, statusRows.status_cd

WITH
SELECT documentInfo.OBJECT_ID AS "objectId", COALESCE(NULLIF(documentInfo.SW_NO, ''), '-') AS "swNo", COALESCE( NULLIF(documentInfo.SW_NM, ''), NULLIF(documentInfo.DRAWING_TITLE, ''), NULLIF(documentInfo.ORG_FILE_NAME, ''), NULLIF(documentInfo.FILE_NAME, ''), '제목 없음' ) AS "documentName", COALESCE(NULLIF(documentInfo.STATUS, ''), '상태 미지정') AS "statusNm", COALESCE(documentInfo.dashboard_grade_cd, 'UNASSIGNED') AS "gradeCd", COALESCE(documentInfo.dashboard_grade_nm, '미지정') AS "gradeNm", COALESCE(documentInfo.dashboard_grade_level, 0)::integer AS "gradeLevel", COALESCE(NULLIF(documentInfo.REGISTER_USER, ''), NULLIF(documentInfo.INSERT_UID, ''), '-') AS "registerUser", COALESCE(documentInfo.REQUESTED_NO, '') AS "requestNo", TO_CHAR( COALESCE(documentInfo.CREATE_DT, documentInfo.INSERT_DT, documentInfo.INPUT_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS "registeredAt", ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DOCS_SW_FILE fileInfo WHERE fileInfo.OBJECT_ID = documentInfo.OBJECT_ID) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DOCS_SW_SUB_FILE subFile WHERE subFile.PARENT_OBJECT_ID = documentInfo.OBJECT_ID AND COALESCE(subFile.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y') )::integer AS "fileCount" FROM document_scope documentInfo ORDER BY COALESCE(documentInfo.CREATE_DT, documentInfo.INSERT_DT, documentInfo.INPUT_DATE) DESC NULLS LAST, documentInfo.OBJECT_ID LIMIT 6

WITH , activity_event AS ( SELECT ('VIEW-' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY viewHistory.INSERT_DATE, viewHistory.OBJECT_ID )) AS event_id, viewHistory.INSERT_DATE AS occurred_at, 'VIEW' AS action_type, 'ALLOW' AS result_cd, 'VIEWING_HISTORY' AS reason_cd, COALESCE(NULLIF(viewHistory.USER_NM, ''), NULLIF(viewHistory.USER_ID, ''), '-') AS actor_name, viewHistory.USER_ID AS actor_user_id, NULL::varchar AS actor_user_cd, 'SW' AS object_type, viewHistory.OBJECT_ID AS object_id FROM DOCS_HISTORY viewHistory WHERE viewHistory.DISTRIBUTION_TYPE = 'CCB' AND viewHistory.LOG_TYPE = 'VIEWING' UNION ALL SELECT ('AUDIT-' || auditLog.EVENT_ID) AS event_id, auditLog.OCCURRED_AT AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS occurred_at, auditLog.ACTION_TYPE AS action_type, auditLog.RESULT_CD AS result_cd, auditLog.REASON_CD AS reason_cd, COALESCE(NULLIF(auditLog.ACTOR_USER_NM, ''), NULLIF(auditLog.ACTOR_USER_ID, ''), '-') AS actor_name, auditLog.ACTOR_USER_ID AS actor_user_id, auditLog.ACTOR_USER_CD AS actor_user_cd, auditLog.OBJECT_TYPE AS object_type, auditLog.OBJECT_ID AS object_id FROM DOCS_ACCESS_AUDIT_LOG auditLog WHERE ( auditLog.EVENT_TYPE = 'DOWNLOAD_RESULT' AND auditLog.ACTION_TYPE = 'DOWNLOAD_ORIGINAL' ) OR ( auditLog.EVENT_TYPE = 'FILE_ACCESS' AND auditLog.ACTION_TYPE = 'VIEW' AND auditLog.RESULT_CD = 'DENY' ) UNION ALL SELECT ('PRINT-' || printJob.PRINT_JOB_ID) AS event_id, printJob.COMPLETED_AT AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS occurred_at, 'PRINT' AS action_type, CASE WHEN printJob.STATUS_CD = 'SUCCESS' THEN 'ALLOW' ELSE 'DENY' END AS result_cd, printJob.STATUS_CD AS reason_cd, COALESCE(NULLIF(printJob.ACTOR_USER_NM, ''), NULLIF(printJob.ACTOR_USER_ID, ''), '-') AS actor_name, printJob.ACTOR_USER_ID AS actor_user_id, printJob.ACTOR_USER_CD AS actor_user_cd, printItem.OBJECT_TYPE AS object_type, printItem.OBJECT_ID AS object_id FROM DOCS_PRINT_JOB printJob JOIN DOCS_PRINT_JOB_ITEM printItem ON printItem.PRINT_JOB_ID = printJob.PRINT_JOB_ID WHERE printJob.COMPLETED_AT IS NOT NULL AND printItem.OBJECT_TYPE IN ('SW', 'SW_SUB') ) SELECT activityEvent.event_id AS "eventId", TO_CHAR(activityEvent.occurred_at, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "occurredAt", activityEvent.action_type AS "actionType", activityEvent.result_cd AS "resultCd", activityEvent.reason_cd AS "reasonCd", activityEvent.actor_name AS "actorName", activityEvent.object_type AS "objectType", activityEvent.object_id AS "objectId", COALESCE(NULLIF(documentInfo.SW_NO, ''), '-') AS "swNo", COALESCE( NULLIF(documentInfo.SW_NM, ''), NULLIF(documentInfo.DRAWING_TITLE, ''), NULLIF(documentInfo.ORG_FILE_NAME, ''), NULLIF(documentInfo.FILE_NAME, ''), '제목 없음' ) AS "documentName", COALESCE(documentInfo.dashboard_grade_cd, 'UNASSIGNED') AS "gradeCd" FROM activity_event activityEvent JOIN document_scope documentInfo ON documentInfo.OBJECT_ID = activityEvent.object_id CROSS JOIN actor_context actor WHERE activityEvent.actor_user_cd = actor.user_cd OR ( activityEvent.actor_user_cd IS NULL AND activityEvent.actor_user_id = actor.user_id ) ORDER BY activityEvent.occurred_at DESC, activityEvent.event_id DESC LIMIT 8
